program='''def transform(grid):
    split = len(grid[0]) // 2
    left = [row[:split] for row in grid]
    right = [row[split + 1:] for row in grid]
    common = set(value for row in left for value in row) & set(value for row in right for value in row)
    fill = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else fill for c in range(split)]
            for r in range(len(grid))]
'''
path.write_text(program)
exec(compile(program,str(path),'exec'))
